scripts.build: echo "🔍 Validating CPI Artifacts..." && FILE=$(find iflows -name '*.zip' | sort -V | tail -1) && BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE") && echo "Processing $FILE" && unzip -t "$FILE" && mkdir -p dist && cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME" && echo "USER=$nexus_usr" && echo "📦 Uploading to Nexus..." && curl -v -u "$nexus_usr:$nexus_psw" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME" && echo "✅ Uploaded Successfully"
